`SKILL.md` is a modified adaptation, not a verbatim upstream copy. It retains deliberate visual direction, typography, meaningful structure, restrained motion, plain interface copy, plan/review/build/critique, and accessibility principles. It removes an assumed client history and default aesthetic-risk requirement, binds implementation to existing approved stack/assets, and adds source-behavior preservation and no-install rules for the modernization workflow. Only name/description frontmatter is used.

The original skill and its license were read before adaptation. The upstream tree contains no skill-local NOTICE file. The repository-wide third-party notices were checked; they do not identify this text-only skill. No upstream executables, fonts, example application code, plugin manifest, hooks, or dependencies are included. This adaptation needs no software installation or script execution. Names identify sources and do not imply endorsement.
